office_does: The Island County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor cases, traffic infractions and civil claims up to $100,000.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Ronald A. Costeck, appointed in 2024 when Judge Bill Hawkins retired, runs for both the short term left on Hawkins's term and the next full four-year term.

candidates.summary: Presiding Judge of Island County District Court since his 2024 appointment, after six years as the court's commissioner; earlier a prosecutor and a private attorney in criminal, family and civil cases.
highlights: Unanimously appointed by county commissioners in 2024 to replace retiring Judge Hawkins [S2]
District and Oak Harbor Municipal Court commissioner from 2018 to 2024 [S1][S2]
Former deputy prosecutor; founded a multi-county practice in criminal, family and civil law in 2005 [S1][S4]
